newsitem.title: CHINA: China state industry loss 1.67 mln yuan in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: China state industry loss 1.67 mln yuan in Jan-Feb.

text.p: China's state-owned industry reported a loss of 1.67 billion yuan in the first two months of this year, the Xinhua news agency said.
However, many state-owned firms made profits, it said.

The top three profit-makers were state enterprises in eastern coastal Shandong province, which generated industrial profits of 252 million yuan, central Henan province which reported profits of 106 million yuan and the bustling metropolis of Shanghai with profits of 103 million yuan.
Sales revenue of state-owned industry reached 339.69 billion yuan in January and February, Xinhua said quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.

Shanghai municipality registered sales revenue of 20.87 billion yuan, followed by Shandong province with revenue of 15.98 billion yuan and eastern Jiangsu province with revenue of 14.86 billion yuan, it said.
